clinic.terms: I have read and agree to the <link>Terms of Service</link>.
clinic.privacy: I have read and understand the <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
clinic.patientConsents: I confirm that my clinic has obtained all legally required patient consents (including explicit consent for processing health and medical data under GDPR/applicable regulations) before entering any personal or health information into this platform.
clinic.accuracy: I confirm that all information entered into the platform will be accurate and kept up to date.
clinic.credentials: I understand that I am responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of my account credentials.

patient.personalData: I confirm that the patient has given explicit consent to the processing of their personal data for post-operative care.

patient.reminders: I confirm that the patient has agreed to receive reminder emails and notifications.
patient.informed: I confirm that the patient has been fully informed about how their personal and health information will be used and stored.

patient.corrections: I understand that I must immediately correct or update any inaccurate patient information upon notice.
